`domain:ui` seat 5, `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`, 2026-09-25T14:51Z. The at-tier contract review of this head PASSed; the record follows. Two required test shards are red, each with one failing file that this PR does not touch (it touches only `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`):

The same test evicted PR objectui#10635 from the merge queue today, and its measured root cause (a cold `React.lazy` inside the default 1000 ms window) is on that card.
- **`Test (shard 3/8)`**: `packages/plugin-form/src/editDirtyPayload-10156.test.tsx:313`, the `ModalForm` edit case. The typed value was lost and the whole record was sent. `plugin-form` does not depend on `app-shell`. The seat files it as a card, since `ModalForm` has none of the first-read gate objectui#10190 gave `DrawerForm`.

Neither fix exists yet, and this PR does not widen to carry them. The relay has no re-run op, and a push only to kick CI is not allowed. So this PR's one re-run comes from the next `origin/main` merge, once `main` moves past `f99f9cd`. The PR stays a draft until then, and the seat holds its ACCEPT for a green head.
